name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: Menu triggers in a row: a Black strip in a hairline with the brand corner, triggers in DM Sans Medium, each opening a panel of rows in the card's #262626 fill. Arrow keys move along the bar and through the rows.
use_for: A tool's commands grouped under a few words, as in an editor: a board's actions, its view, its sharing. Three to five menus.
never: Site or app navigation: use the Sidebar or Navigation Menu
One menu alone: use Dropdown Menu
A spectrum color for the open trigger: it takes the #262626 fill
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no menubar in the brand assets): Black ground, the neutral steps for fills and hairlines, DM Sans Medium for triggers, the plan card's #262626 fill for panels

'use client' import { useState } from 'react' import { Copy, Download, FolderPlus, Link, Trash2, UserPlus } from 'lucide-react' import { Menubar } from '@/react/components/ui/Menubar' import { MenubarItem } from '@/react/components/ui/MenubarItem' import { MenubarLabel } from '@/react/components/ui/MenubarLabel' import { MenubarMenu } from '@/react/components/ui/MenubarMenu' import { MenubarSeparator } from '@/react/components/ui/MenubarSeparator' // A board's tools as a menubar: the board itself, how its creatives are sorted, and who sees it. Open one, then point // at the next or press Right. const sorts = [{ id: 'newest', label: 'Newest first' }, { id: 'longest', label: 'Longest running' }, { id: 'saved', label: 'Most saved' }] as const export default function Board() { const [sort, setSort] = useState<'newest' | 'longest' | 'saved'>('newest') return (
New board Duplicate Export as PDF Delete board Sort creatives {sorts.map((s) => ( setSort(s.id)}>{s.label} ))} Copy link Invite a teammate
) }
